content.title: 300/500 Assisted Promotional Housing
summary: The completed 300-home phase of a 500-home Assisted Promotional Housing (LPA) programme in Douaouda, comprising ground floor plus 8 upper floors (R+8) residential blocks, integrated commercial premises, and comprehensive roads and utility networks (VRD).

Douaouda brings the completed 300-home phase of a 500-home assisted promotional housing programme into a coastal setting, pairing family housing with professional premises and organised exterior works.
description: The project was executed under a complete all-trades package (TCE), encompassing reinforced concrete structural works, secondary trades, building services coordination, and exterior finishing.

The R+8 blocks are configured with F3 and F4 apartment layouts. The ground-level commercial spaces establish active street-level frontage, integrating local retail and services directly into the residential fabric.
content.authority: A multi-storey residential development delivered through unified structural engineering, building services integration, and site circulation works.

faq.question: What is the scope of the 300/500 Assisted Promotional Housing project?
faq.answer: It represents the completed 300-home phase of a larger 500-home Assisted Promotional Housing (LPA) development in Douaouda, featuring R+8 residential blocks and integrated commercial premises.

faq.question: What construction services were provided for this development?
faq.answer: The project was executed under an all-trades delivery (TCE) contract, covering reinforced concrete structures, secondary trades, building services, and roads and utility networks (VRD).

faq.question: Who is the client for this housing programme?
faq.answer: The development was delivered for the National Housing Improvement and Development Agency (AADL) under the state-assisted promotional housing framework.

faq.question: How are the residential blocks configured?
faq.answer: Douaouda brings the completed 300-home phase of a 500-home assisted promotional housing programme into a coastal setting, pairing family housing with professional premises and organised exterior works.

hero.alt: A wide shot of a large construction site with several multi-story concrete residential buildings in various stages of structural completion. A tall tower crane is visible in the background, extending over the buildings. The ground is reddish-brown dirt, and the sky is overcast.
hero.caption: Structural concrete works in progress across the residential blocks.

hero.alt: A vertical shot of a construction site under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, red-brown excavated earth and some green vegetation. In the midground, a tall, grey concrete structure (likely a core) with red formwork at the top, and to its right, another multi-story building with concrete frames and red brick infill. A large blue tower crane with 'UNEN COMANSA' visible on its boom extends across the sky. Below the crane, a concrete pump truck and two cement mixer trucks are visible. In the far background, the blue sea is visible.
hero.caption: Structural framing and masonry infill works underway, showing the coastal site context.

intro.alt: An aerial shot showing several large, beige apartment blocks with brown roofs, surrounded by unpaved ground and some construction materials. Older, smaller buildings are in the foreground, and a body of water is visible in the distant background under a cloudy sky.
intro.caption: Aerial view of the completed R+8 residential blocks in Douaouda.
